title_sq: VILE PER SHITJE TEK LIQENI I THATE
description_sq: Ofrohet per shitje nje vile 3 kateshe, e cila ndodhet ne zonen e Liqenit te Thate. Vila ka nje siperfaqje totale ndertimi 400m2, ku cdo kat ka siperfaqje 133m2, dhe oborr me siperfaqje 347 m2. Kati perdhe eshte i organizuar ne nje dhome gjumi ,nje tualet me dritare, nje korridor te gjate , nje soxhorno shum te bollshme e cila eshte e shtruar e gjitha me mermes, dhe ambjenti gatimit i vecuar. Kati nentoke eshte i organizuar ne nje garazh i pershtatshem per dy makina, nje dhome lavanderi, dhe nje ambjent i cili mund te pershtatet si dhome gjumi ose hapesire relaksi dhe nje tualet. Kati i dyte eshte i organizuar ne 3 dhoma gjumi, ku dhoma matrimoniale ka nje garderobe te brendshme dhe nje tualet me dritare, dhe nje tualet tjeter i cili eshte ne funksion te dy dhomave te tjera te gjumit. Vila eshte e termoizoluar, cka sjell eficence te larte ne ruajtjen e temperatures se brendshme dhe kursimin e energjise elektrike. Ka nje sistem kamerash te brendshem dhe te jashtem, dhe sistem alarmi. Sistem qendror kondicionimi MITSUBISHI,panel diellor, filter uji,linje tre fazore,dere te blinduar ,depozite 300 L,dritaret jane triplex te markes REHAU. Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor. Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone mos hezitoni te me kontaktoni.
title_en: VILLA FOR SALE AT DRY LAKE
description_en: A 3-storey villa is offered for sale, which is located in the Dry Lake area. The villa has a total construction area of ​​400 m2, where each floor has an area of ​​133 m2, and a yard with an area of ​​347 m2. The ground floor is organized into a bedroom, a bathroom with a window, a long corridor, a very spacious living room which is all tiled, and a separate kitchen area. The basement is organized in a garage suitable for two cars, a laundry room, and an area that can be adapted as a bedroom or relaxation space and a toilet. The second floor is organized into 3 bedrooms, where the master bedroom has an internal wardrobe and a toilet with a window, and another toilet which is the function of the other two bedrooms. The villa is thermally insulated, which brings high efficiency in maintaining the internal temperature and saving electricity. It has an internal and external camera system, and an alarm system. MITSUBISHI central air conditioning system, solar panel, water filter, three-phase line, armored door, 300 L tank, REHAU brand triplex windows. Has regular mortgage documentation. For more information or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact me.
